careers

we're not hiring yet. we will be, and here's what the seats look like.

infinite hill is being built by a very small team in Los Angeles with a lot of help from people who know more than we do. when we open roles, they'll be these first:

founding technical lead — owns the app, the content pipeline, and the question "are we on the best tools this month." small team, huge leverage.

head of curriculum — runs the writing room and the Keeper Desk. loves scripture, hates sermons. can tell a story in the length of a song.

illustrator + motion — our character is the kid in the backwards cap, and the sun. it needs a person who can make them move without redrawing a face.

community and hosts — for golden hour nights and the table, once they exist: the people who'll run the room in your city.

what everyone here has in common

you've sat in a service for a religion that isn't yours and found it beautiful. you think being a good person is the coolest thing a person can be. you'd rather ship something small that's right than something big that's loud.

no form yet. when the roles are live, they'll be here.
